description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). CREATE TABLE D (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_D PRIMARY KEY); IDs 1..1200 INSERTed ascending (r-q7 long-split: an intermediate root over two leaves, several data pages). Close. A shared session runs DELETE FROM D with dbFailOnError (RecordsAffected read) and closes. Pages 0, 1 and 42-81 are kept and pages 0-81 hashed after the populating session and after the delete session. Asks which pages DELETE without WHERE releases, in which maps, and what it writes in the pages it releases and the index pages.
